sources.title: Luso Overland — MONTERO Gen 2, 2.5, 3; SPORT Updated V6 Crankshaft Center Bolt & Washer Set: «the original bolt design was defective and would often back out & break, ruining the crankshaft», plus the flush-bolt-head identification test

NHTSA recalls database — Mitsubishi Montero, 1996 model year: campaign 00V311001, crankshaft pulley bolt on 3.0L Montero, Montero Sport and 1.5L Mirage engines. Consequence: loss of power steering assist. Remedy on Montero models: tighten to the correct torque specification, replace the bolt only if damaged. Adjacent generation and engine, not this one

Luso Overland — MONTERO Gen3 OEM Timing Belt Kit: recommended additional items, «Revised Crank bolt & Washer — If your Montero is still running with the original defective crank bolt, now is the time to get that out of there!»

en.title: Original crankshaft bolt backing out
en.summary: The Montero specialist who supplies the updated fastener describes the original crankshaft centre bolt as a defective design that would often back out and break, ruining the crankshaft and sometimes other engine components with it, and sells the replacement with thread locker already applied. They also give the test that makes this checkable without dismantling anything: the original bolt was much longer, so if the head sits almost flush with the end of the pulley, it is the old one. Mitsubishi ran a factory campaign for the same fastener on the previous generation's smaller V6 and on another model. That campaign is not this engine and this entry does not claim it is — but it is worth reading, because the manufacturer's own stated consequence is a loss of power steering assist and an increased risk of a crash, and the manufacturer's own remedy was to tighten the bolt to the correct torque specification, replacing it only where it was damaged. That is why this entry says drive gently and get it checked rather than stop driving. The exception is if the bolt is already going: a pulley you can see wobbling, a knock from the nose of the crankshaft, or a thrown accessory belt is the failure in progress, and that truck should not be driven.

symptoms.bolt-head-sits-almost-flush-with-the-pul: The crankshaft bolt head sits almost flush with the end of the pulley
symptoms.wobble-or-knock-at-the-crankshaft-pulley: A visible wobble or a knock at the crankshaft pulley with the engine running
symptoms.accessory-belt-thrown-or-shredded: The accessory drive belt thrown off or shredded
symptoms.battery-light-and-heavy-steering-at-the-: The battery warning light and heavy steering arriving together

causes.original-long-crank-bolt-still-fitted: The original long-pattern crankshaft bolt is still in the engine
causes.crank-bolt-backed-out-or-broken: The crankshaft bolt has already backed out or broken
causes.belt-tensioner-or-idler-seized: A tensioner or idler pulley has seized and thrown the belt

diagnosticSteps.compare-the-bolt-head-with-the-end-of-th: Look at the crankshaft bolt head and see whether it stands proud of the pulley or sits almost flush with it
diagnosticSteps.watch-the-crankshaft-pulley-at-idle-for-: Watch the crankshaft pulley at idle from the side and look for wobble or movement on the nose
diagnosticSteps.spin-each-accessory-pulley-by-hand-with-: With the accessory belt off, spin each pulley by hand and feel for roughness or drag

have-the-bolt-checked-against-the-torque.title: Have the bolt checked against the torque specification
have-the-bolt-checked-against-the-torque.detail: This is what the factory campaign on the earlier engine asked dealers to do, and it is the cheapest way to find out whether yours has started to move. The figure is a factory specification and belongs on a torque wrench, not on feel.

fit-the-updated-crank-bolt-and-washer.title: Fit the updated bolt and washer
fit-the-updated-crank-bolt-and-washer.detail: The updated bolt comes with thread locker already applied, and the washer is directional — the bevelled side faces the bolt head. Best done as part of a timing belt service, because that is when the pulley is off anyway.

replace-the-tensioner-and-idler-pulleys.title: Replace the accessory tensioner and idlers
replace-the-tensioner-and-idler-pulleys.detail: The other reason a belt leaves. Cheaper than the bolt job, and worth confirming first if the pulley itself runs true.

es.title: Tornillo original del cigüeñal aflojándose
es.summary: La casa especializada en Montero que suministra el tornillo actualizado describe el tornillo central original del cigüeñal como un diseño defectuoso que se aflojaba y se quebraba con frecuencia, arruinando el cigüeñal y a veces otras piezas del motor, y vende el repuesto con traba-roscas ya aplicado. También dan la prueba que permite revisarlo sin desarmar nada: el tornillo original era mucho más largo, así que si la cabeza queda casi al ras con la punta de la polea, es el viejo. Mitsubishi corrió una campaña de fábrica por el mismo tornillo en el V6 más pequeño de la generación anterior y en otro modelo. Esa campaña no es de este motor y esta entrada no pretende que lo sea, pero vale leerla: la consecuencia que declara el propio fabricante es la pérdida de asistencia de la dirección hidráulica y mayor riesgo de choque, y la solución del propio fabricante fue apretar el tornillo al torque correcto y cambiarlo solo donde estuviera dañado. Por eso esta entrada dice manejar suave y mandarlo a revisar, y no dejar de manejar. La excepción es cuando el tornillo ya va cediendo: una polea que usted ve bambolearse, un golpeteo en la punta del cigüeñal, o una faja de accesorios botada son la falla en curso, y ese vehículo no se debe manejar.

symptoms.bolt-head-sits-almost-flush-with-the-pul: La cabeza del tornillo del cigüeñal queda casi al ras con la punta de la polea
symptoms.wobble-or-knock-at-the-crankshaft-pulley: Un bamboleo visible o un golpeteo en la polea del cigüeñal con el motor andando
symptoms.accessory-belt-thrown-or-shredded: La faja de accesorios botada o deshilachada
symptoms.battery-light-and-heavy-steering-at-the-: La luz de la batería y la dirección pesada apareciendo al mismo tiempo

causes.original-long-crank-bolt-still-fitted: El tornillo largo original del cigüeñal sigue puesto en el motor
causes.crank-bolt-backed-out-or-broken: El tornillo del cigüeñal ya se aflojó o se quebró
causes.belt-tensioner-or-idler-seized: Un tensor o una polea loca se trabó y botó la faja

diagnosticSteps.compare-the-bolt-head-with-the-end-of-th: Mire la cabeza del tornillo del cigüeñal y vea si sobresale de la polea o si queda casi al ras con ella
diagnosticSteps.watch-the-crankshaft-pulley-at-idle-for-: Observe de lado la polea del cigüeñal en marcha mínima y busque bamboleo o movimiento en la punta
diagnosticSteps.spin-each-accessory-pulley-by-hand-with-: Con la faja de accesorios quitada, gire cada polea con la mano y sienta si raspa o se arrastra

have-the-bolt-checked-against-the-torque.title: Que le revisen el tornillo contra la especificación de torque
have-the-bolt-checked-against-the-torque.detail: Es lo que la campaña de fábrica del motor anterior les pidió hacer a los concesionarios, y es la forma más barata de averiguar si el suyo ya empezó a moverse. La cifra es una especificación de fábrica y va en llave de torque, no al tacto.

fit-the-updated-crank-bolt-and-washer.title: Montar el tornillo y la arandela actualizados
fit-the-updated-crank-bolt-and-washer.detail: El tornillo actualizado viene con traba-roscas ya aplicado, y la arandela tiene sentido: el lado biselado va hacia la cabeza del tornillo. Conviene hacerlo dentro del servicio de faja de distribución, porque ahí la polea ya está afuera.

replace-the-tensioner-and-idler-pulleys.title: Cambiar el tensor y las poleas locas de accesorios
replace-the-tensioner-and-idler-pulleys.detail: Es la otra razón por la que se va una faja. Sale más barato que el trabajo del tornillo, y si la polea gira derecha vale confirmarlo primero.
